name: Joey Calca
biography: is a member of the Hacked Existence Team. He is a recent graduate from Arizona State University with a Business Degree in Computer Information Systems and a background in Computer Systems Engineering. He has done various consulting projects including the design and implementation of large scale multimedia delivery systems, and is currently pursuing Cloud Computing as the next big technology boom.
